description: EXPLORATORY scoping of the muon-anchored Hecke-energy route to m_tau (bean qou-se9w), after the census route closed. Tests a CLOSED pre-declared list of candidates for the dimensionless factor F_tau = m_tau/m_mu = 16.8170, each built only from corpus-canonical objects (chi_(2,1), Seifert volumes, quantum integers, hbar_q). All residuals reported, matches and misses alike. NOT a fit and NOT wired: a near-match here is a candidate requiring independent structural derivation, not a result.

data.verdict: No pre-declared candidate reaches 1% of the target; the best is (chi7/chi5)/hbar_q at 12.338416% . The muon-anchored Hecke route does NOT close m_tau with the corpus's existing factor vocabulary — an honest negative. Closing it requires a new structural ingredient (e.g. a genuine Markov trace of the tau braid in a higher-strand algebra, or the lepton-sector analogue of the nucleon's -6*m_e binding subtraction), not another combination of these factors.
